name: LCROSS Centaur
loreDescription: My name is LCROSS: Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite. I wasn’t born by accident, but out of a question that had been bugging scientists for decades: Is there water on the Moon?

name: Luna 2
loreDescription: I am Luna 2, a Soviet spacecraft that became the first human-made object to successfully reach the Moon’s surface.

name: Luna Orbiter
loreDescription: I am the Lunar Orbiter, part of a fleet of five NASA spacecraft tasked with mapping the Moon’s surface and identifying safe landing sites for the Apollo astronauts.

name: Luna 9
loreDescription: I am Luna 9, a Soviet spacecraft that became the first in history to successfully perform a soft landing on the Moon’s surface.

name: Ranger 7
loreDescription: I am Ranger 7, a NASA spacecraft that successfully transmitted thousands of close-up images of the Moon’s surface before finally crashing into it.

name: Surveyor 3
loreDescription: I am Surveyor 3, an unmanned lander belonging to the United States, tasked with studying the lunar soil and confirming that the Moon’s surface is suitable for human landing.

name: Lunokhod
loreDescription: I am Lunokhod 1, an eight-wheeled rover from the Soviet Union—the first wheeled vehicle ever to traverse the Moon’s surface.

name: Eagle (Apollo 11)
loreDescription: I am a remnant of the Eagle, the descent stage of the Apollo 11 lunar module—the platform that supported humanity’s first steps on the Moon.

name: Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle
loreDescription: I am the Lunar Roving Vehicle from the Apollo 15 mission, the first motorized vehicle ever transported to and driven by humans on another world.

name: Vikram Lander
loreDescription: I am Vikram, India’s youngest lander, named in honor of Vikram Sarabhai, the father of India’s space program.

name: Chandrayaan-1
loreDescription: I am Chandrayaan-1, whose name means ‘Lunar Probe’ in Sanskrit—India’s first space mission and its first journey to the Moon.
